howto: Pick a level and press Play. The game says a word out loud.
Spell it with the letter keys, then tap the tick to check.
Three wrong spellings end the game. Spell 8 in a row to win a heart back.
tips: Tap the turtle to hear the word extra slowly and listen for each sound.
The light bulb shows the next letter once per word, for 5 points.
Words you miss go on your Tricky list. Spell them right later to clear them.
Spelling a word within about 4 seconds earns a +3 fast bonus.
No voice on this device? The word flashes on screen for a moment instead.

controls.keyboard: Type letters, Backspace deletes, Enter checks. Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap the on-screen letters, the back arrow and the tick

difficulty: Five level bands by word length, each with an age guide: Easy 3-4 letters (ages 5-6), Medium 4-5 (6-7), Hard 5-6 (7-8), Insane 6-7 (8-9) and Max 7-9 (9 and up). Higher bands unlock with XP.

features.age-or-level-bands: Five levels on the title, each labelled with word length and an age guide
features.hints: The light bulb shows the next letter; the arcade Hint gives the first letter, spots a wrong letter, or names the next one
features.grown-up-progress-report: Grown-ups button on the title: words tried and accuracy per level, practice days, the words missed most and a suggested next level
features.tutorial: Coach cards on the first game: listen, type, check and hints; replay with Learn to play
features.results: Game Over card with score, best, best streak, flawless runs and word rank
